first.rationale: Prioritize a focused onboarding-simplification experiment because completion is currently down and prior evidence links shorter onboarding and simpler signup to faster time-to-value and early activation. Verify the onboarding and activation records to confirm segment scope and downstream-quality evidence before launch. Do not use broad promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: inherited evidence shows acquisition lift but material 30-day retention harm, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding-simplification experiment this week. It directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and is supported by confirmed evidence of +13% completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and +3% 30-day retention; prior signup simplification also lifted SMB first-week activation. Activation messaging remains a credible follow-up, but the current completion decline makes onboarding the more direct leverage point. Do not respond to competitor pricing with promotional pricing: its known retention harm conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
